Hi Nathan,

You're right to be frustrated, and I'm not going to give you another run around.

Here is the honest position on both. Shop···· is the Magic Miner 40T Wave 1 with the Miner Duster and Power Kit, paid, nothing shipped. We told you on September 27 it would ship October 31. That date has now passed. At our Chattanooga warehouse the Duster is sitting reserved for you, but the 40T itself and the Power Kit are still waiting on incoming stock.

Shop···· is the Harlo B30 with a Power Kit, also paid and unshipped. The September 15 notice put it in mid October, and that has passed too. Same picture at the warehouse: the Power Kit is reserved, the B30 is waiting on stock.

So the truthful answer is that neither unit is on a shelf today, and I will not invent a new date for you after two that did not hold. I have put both orders in front of the team with the warehouse detail, and they pick this up tomorrow morning at 10am ET. You will get the real dates by email in this same thread, from a person, not another holding message.

Your $50 code from October, HD-••••••, is still yours and still valid.

Sorry for how long this has run.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
